name: Milo Roche
life: “I still remember a folding chair used for my first staff hearing.” Friday often includes a stop at the market by Market Flats, where Milo often waits until the delivery baskets are stacked before going in.
voice: I rent the space next door. I offered enough folding chairs for the meeting, whatever they decide.
appearance: Milo has short, uneven waves that refuse to lie flat, fine brows over wide-set eyes, and a favorite piece of clothing, a soft blue checked shirt. It usually goes with a pressed flower kept in the clear back of a phone case. When somebody else has the floor, Milo rubs a thumb along the edge of the nearest pocket.
personality: Milo has a strong competitive streak and a very soft spot for the person finishing last. A prize tastes better when everybody had enough time to enter.
agenda: To host a meeting where either choice is welcome.
family: Lars James is Milo’s first cousin once removed. Milo leaves the first voice message. Lars calls back when there is finally a little privacy. In their family a missed ring can mean a bus, a customer, a sleeping child or a bad hour. Neither treats it as an answer in itself. Asked about *Land without cranes*, Lars says, “I want a desk job here someday, but the new rents won't buy one for anyone I know.”
connections: Hollis Aranda. A meeting next door gives the advertiser a real public update on the canceled event.

reactions.situation: An apprentice asks if declining will cost future shifts
reactions.response: Milo asks the owner to give the apprentice a direct answer in front of a witness of their choosing.

reactions.situation: Someone offers a cash reward for naming a rumored culprit
reactions.response: Milo asks what evidence supports the accusation and declines to supply a name on gossip alone.
